name: docs-workflows
description: Commands for a product's documentation and release notes. /docs-init scaffolds a docs repository from nothing: a MkDocs skeleton, public and internal builds, Vale, CI and a profile. /docs-brand applies a logo and colours taken from the product's code, contrast-checked. /docs-serve runs the site's dev server. /docs-audit turns the product's code and specs into a coverage grid and a prioritised backlog of missing pages; /docs-write drafts a unit's page from its evidence, and /docs-verify resolves its claims by a code read or a walk, each committing on a branch behind an Opus review gate. /document edits prose directly, or keyed to a PRD folder writes product docs from its implementation diffs behind an Opus review gate. /docs-profile refreshes the repository's profile; /release-notes drafts a destination-shaped entry from the same folder. Depends on workflows-core and prose-style.
